title: Seedream 5 joins image generation
summary:
New image models from Seedream and Gemini, a Gemini Pro upgrade, and a bit of housekeeping for the project showcase.

Added the paid `seedream5` model for text-to-image and image-to-image generation, with support for up to 14 input images. The older Seedream names remain callable but no longer appear in the model list.

Added the paid `nanobanana-2` image model for text and image inputs, and moved `gemini-large` to Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview. The older Gemini 3 Pro names still point to their original model rather than quietly changing underneath existing requests.

The pitch page now contains a seven-slide Pollinations presentation instead of a coming-soon screen. A community catalog entry was also updated to reflect BotForgeX Laboratories’ web app, chatbot templates, and multimodal options.

highlights.title: Seedream 5 image generation
highlights.text: Use `seedream5` for text-to-image or image-to-image generation with up to 14 input images. It’s a paid model. [Browse seedream5](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=seedream5).

highlights.title: Nano Banana 2
highlights.text: Generate images from text or image inputs with `nanobanana-2`, backed by Gemini 3.1 Flash Image. It’s a paid model and also accepts the name `nanobanana2`. [Browse nanobanana-2](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=nanobanana-2).

highlights.title: Gemini Large gets 3.1 Pro
highlights.text: `gemini-large` now routes to Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, also available as `gemini-3.1-pro`. Existing Gemini 3 Pro model names still route to the older version. [Browse gemini-large](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gemini-large).
